title: Skip-Thinking: Chunk-wise Chain-of-Thought Distillation Enable Smaller Language Models to Reason Better and Faster
authors_zh: Xiaoshu Chen；Sihang Zhou；Ke Liang；Xiaoyu Sun；Xinwang Liu
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: A selective CoT compression approach that treats omitted intermediate steps as a controlled construction decision.
Skip-Thinking 以 text-davinci-002 生成的 CoT 为教师轨迹，按 chunk 进行 CWT、SBC 与 STT 等选择性跳过，以训练更短的推理。
why: It helps audit long-to-short trace transformations, especially the need to retain chunking and deletion decisions alongside resulting text.
inclusion_reason: It helps audit long-to-short trace transformations, especially the need to retain chunking and deletion decisions alongside resulting text.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official EMNLP 2025 paper studies a specific weakness of chain-of-thought distillation: a small language model is usually trained against an entire teacher rationale in one update, so many transitional or stylistic tokens can dilute the gradient contribution of the tokens that carry the next reasoning dependency. The resulting model must also emit the full rationale before its answer, increasing response time. The paper tests whether the rationale can be divided and selectively shortened without abandoning explicit reasoning altogether.

For this atlas, the relevant object is not merely the final student model. It is the transformation from a question, answer, and text-davinci-002 rationale into chunked training examples and retained or skipped chunks. The decision boundary is answer correctness after removing a chunk: a chunk whose removal preserves the answer is treated as non-essential for the Skip-Thinking training recipe. This is an algorithmic construction signal, not proof that the removed text is causally irrelevant, and no reusable compressed-trace release was verified.

EMNLP 2025 正式论文研究了 CoT distillation 的一个具体缺陷：小语言模型通常在一次更新中学习完整教师 rationale，大量过渡性或表达性 token 会稀释承载后续推理依赖的核心 token 的梯度；同时，模型必须先生成完整 rationale 才能给出答案，响应更慢。论文据此检验能否把 rationale 分块并选择性缩短，同时保留部分显式推理。

对本图谱而言，关键对象并非只有最终学生模型，而是从问题、答案和 text-davinci-002 rationale 到分块训练样本及保留或跳过 chunk 的转换。其决策边界是删除某个 chunk 后答案是否仍正确：若答案不变，该 chunk 在 Skip-Thinking 训练配方中被视为非必要。这是算法式构造信号，并不能证明被删文本在因果上无关；本次也未核实到可复用的压缩轨迹发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Skip-Thinking separates the recipe into Chunk-Wise Training (CWT) and Skip-Thinking Training (STT). CWT converts one long rationale into staged prefix-to-next-chunk examples so the student learns one chunk at a time. Its Search-Based Chunking (SBC) starts from chunk boundaries and greedily adjusts them using the current student's loss as a heuristic for internally coherent, learnable segments. STT then removes chunks one by one, runs the CWT-trained student toward the answer, and labels a removed chunk as skippable only when answer correctness is preserved.

The data object is therefore a teacher rationale plus evolving chunk boundaries, per-chunk loss comparisons, deletion trials, answer-correctness outcomes, and the final retained/skipped sequence. The feedback contract is programmatic at the answer level but only a proxy at the chunk level. Unlike full-rationale CoT distillation, the method changes the unit of supervision; unlike fully latent reasoning, it retains selected explicit chunks. Teacher-generated CoT, chunking, and rationale internalization are not individually new—the contribution is their loss-guided and correctness-gated combination.

Skip-Thinking 将配方拆为 Chunk-Wise Training（CWT）和 Skip-Thinking Training（STT）。CWT 把一条长 rationale 转换成分阶段的“前缀到下一 chunk”训练样本，使学生模型每次学习一个 chunk。其 Search-Based Chunking（SBC）从既有边界出发，以当前学生模型的 loss 作为启发式信号，贪心调整出内部较连贯、较易学习的分段。STT 随后逐个移除 chunk，让已完成 CWT 的学生模型继续预测答案；只有答案仍正确时，才把该 chunk 标为可跳过。

因此，数据对象应包括教师 rationale、不断变化的 chunk 边界、逐 chunk loss 比较、删除试验、答案正确性结果以及最终保留/跳过序列。反馈契约在答案层面是程序式的，但映射到 chunk 重要性时仅是代理信号。与完整 rationale 的 CoT distillation 相比，它改变了监督单元；与完全 latent reasoning 相比，它保留部分显式 chunk。教师生成 CoT、分块和 rationale internalization 本身并非全新，贡献在于将 loss 引导与正确性门控组合起来。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline begins with task examples containing a question and answer. Following the setup attributed to Ho et al., text-davinci-002 generates rationales with few-shot exemplars whose rationale and answer positions are swapped, a maximum sequence length of 128, and temperature 0.7. The experiments use seven reasoning benchmarks spanning arithmetic, symbolic, commonsense, and shuffled-object reasoning, with GPT-2 and T5 variants as students. The paper follows the earlier work's train/test partitioning; a released item-level manifest and decontamination record were not verified.

CWT first partitions each rationale into a fixed number of chunks. Average Chunking is the starting comparison, while SBC merges adjacent material and searches possible cut positions, accepting a boundary change when the student's loss improves beyond a threshold. The resulting examples use stage markers and prefixes so that each chunk, followed by the answer stage, becomes a separate target. The boundary search is updated with the student during training rather than being a one-time semantic annotation.

For STT, the skip data generator removes a candidate chunk, supplies the preceding context and stage marker to the CWT-trained student, and checks the predicted answer. An incorrect answer means the chunk must remain explicit; a correct answer makes it eligible for internalization. Training uses the resulting skip examples, and inference uses the paper's special skip control to emit only retained reasoning chunks before the answer. The verifier is the benchmark answer predicate, not a step verifier. Code, processed chunk data, per-removal logs, seeds, and exact replay environment remain unavailable in the confirmed artifacts.

流程从含问题与答案的任务样本开始。按照论文所沿用的 Ho et al. 设置，text-davinci-002 使用调换了 rationale 与 answer 位置的 few-shot exemplar 生成 rationale，最大序列长度为 128，temperature 为 0.7。实验覆盖算术、符号、常识和物体置换推理等七个 benchmark，学生模型为不同规模的 GPT-2 与 T5。论文沿用前作的训练/测试划分；本次未核实到条目级 manifest 或去污染记录。

CWT 先把每条 rationale 划成固定数量的 chunk。Average Chunking 是对照起点；SBC 会合并相邻内容、枚举可能切点，并在学生模型 loss 的改善超过阈值时接受边界调整。生成的训练样本带有阶段标记和前缀，使每个 chunk 以及最后的答案阶段分别成为训练目标。边界搜索会随学生模型训练更新，并非一次性的语义标注。

在 STT 中，skip data generator 移除候选 chunk，把此前上下文和阶段标记交给完成 CWT 的学生模型，再检查预测答案。答案错误表示该 chunk 必须显式保留；答案正确则使其具备 internalization 资格。模型随后使用这些 skip 样本训练，并在推理时通过论文定义的特殊 skip 控制只输出保留的推理 chunk 后再作答。这里的 verifier 是 benchmark 答案判定，而非 step verifier。经确认的 artifact 未提供代码、处理后 chunk 数据、逐次删除日志、seed 或完整复现环境。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports ablations and comparisons across seven tasks and multiple GPT-2 and T5 student sizes. Its tables compare full-thinking training, average chunking, Search-Based Chunking, and Skip-Thinking Training, while latency analyses show that speedup depends on how many chunks a task can omit. The authors also note that Last Letter Concatenation retains almost the full process because its subtasks have little removable intermediate reasoning, so Skip-Thinking does not uniformly shorten every task.

These experiments support the narrower claim that the proposed training and deletion procedure can trade explicit rationale length against task accuracy in the studied settings. They do not establish that each skipped chunk is genuinely non-reasoning, that the teacher rationales are faithful, or that the derived records form a high-quality reusable dataset. The official ACL Anthology paper and citation are verified; no official code repository, rationale package, chunk labels, trained model release, or item-level construction log was confirmed.

论文在七项任务和多种 GPT-2、T5 学生规模上报告了消融与对比。表格比较 full-thinking training、average chunking、Search-Based Chunking 与 Skip-Thinking Training；延迟分析则显示，提速取决于具体任务能够省略多少 chunk。作者还指出，Last Letter Concatenation 的各子任务几乎没有可移除的中间推理，因此会保留近乎完整的过程，Skip-Thinking 并不会对所有任务产生同等缩短。

这些实验支持的是较窄结论：在所研究设置中，该训练与删除流程可以在显式 rationale 长度和任务准确率之间形成取舍。它们不能证明每个被跳过的 chunk 都确属“非推理”，也不能证明教师 rationale 忠实或派生记录构成高质量可复用数据集。ACL Anthology 正式论文与引文已经核实；未确认官方代码仓库、rationale 包、chunk 标签、训练模型或条目级构造日志。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is conventional CoT distillation, which supervises the student on the whole rationale in one sequence. CWT changes the supervision unit to a chunk and lets the current student's loss influence chunk boundaries; STT adds a counterfactual deletion test in which answer correctness decides whether a chunk remains visible. This differs from methods that simply ask a teacher to shorten text and from methods that hide all reasoning in latent states.

The direction signal for reasoning-data curation is the explicit treatment of omission as a construction decision. A faithful derivative release would preserve not only compressed text but also the source rationale, boundary revisions, model checkpoint used for each loss estimate, deleted alternatives, answer checks, and final retention labels. What is not new is distillation from an LLM, staged reasoning, or rationale compression in general. The paper's quality signal is downstream task and latency behavior; it is not direct validation of the correctness or faithfulness of chunk labels.

最接近的基线是常规 CoT distillation：学生模型在一条序列中学习完整 rationale。CWT 把监督单元改为 chunk，并让当前学生模型的 loss 参与决定 chunk 边界；STT 再加入反事实删除试验，以答案正确性判断 chunk 是否继续显式出现。这不同于仅让教师缩写文本，也不同于把全部推理都隐藏进 latent state 的方法。

对推理数据整理而言，方向信号在于把“省略”明确视为构造决策。忠实的派生发布不应只保留压缩文本，还应保存源 rationale、边界 revision、每次 loss 估计所用模型 checkpoint、被删备选、答案检查及最终保留标签。LLM distillation、分阶段推理和一般意义上的 rationale compression 并非本文新创。论文的质量信号来自下游任务表现与延迟，而不是对 chunk 标签正确性或忠实性的直接验证。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors identify a specific optimization limit: SBC is greedy and can settle on locally rather than globally optimal chunk modes. More broadly, the student's loss is model- and checkpoint-dependent, so the same rationale may receive different boundaries under another student or training stage. Answer preservation after deletion is a weak causal test: a model can guess correctly, exploit shortcuts, or rely on redundant wording even when a removed chunk contains useful reasoning.

The study uses teacher rationales from text-davinci-002 with a length cap and task suite inherited from an earlier protocol. Teacher errors, style artifacts, toxicity, source licensing, prompt overlap, and contamination are not fully documented. Selective deletion can hide uncertainty or dependencies, and some tasks show little acceleration. No confirmed code or trace release exposes boundaries, loss histories, rejected deletions, random seeds, or licenses. Benchmark accuracy and latency gains therefore cannot be used as proof of data-object quality or replayability.

作者明确指出一个优化限制：SBC 使用贪心搜索，可能停在局部最优而非全局最优的 chunk 方案。更一般地，学生模型 loss 依赖模型与 checkpoint，同一条 rationale 在另一学生模型或训练阶段可能得到不同边界。删除后答案不变只是较弱的因果检验：模型可能猜对、利用捷径，或借助冗余表达作答，即使被删 chunk 含有有用推理。

研究使用受长度上限约束的 text-davinci-002 教师 rationale，任务套件沿用既有协议。教师错误、风格伪影、毒性、来源许可证、prompt 重叠与污染控制均未完整披露。选择性删除可能隐藏不确定性或依赖关系，且部分任务几乎没有提速。未确认的代码或轨迹发布也意味着边界、loss 历史、被拒删除、随机 seed 与许可证无法审计。因此，benchmark 准确率和延迟改善不能作为数据对象质量或可回放性的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, Skip-Thinking is useful as a training-time trace-transformation case rather than a test-time search corpus. It shows that a shortened rationale has a hidden lineage: multiple possible boundaries and deletion trials precede the visible output. That lineage is necessary when comparing long-to-short distillation recipes or studying whether compression removes redundancy, uncertainty, or essential dependencies.

A reusable schema should store the task item and split, teacher prompt and version, original rationale and answer, initial and revised chunk boundaries, stage markers, student checkpoint, per-candidate loss, threshold decision, removal order, every predicted answer and correctness check, retained/skipped label, final compressed trace, and downstream model setting. Training-time construction signals must remain separate from evaluation accuracy. Without those records, the paper is most useful as a recipe and audit checklist, not as an open dataset source.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 这一分类，Skip-Thinking 更适合作为训练时轨迹变换案例，而非测试时搜索语料。它说明一条短 rationale 背后存在隐藏 lineage：可见输出形成之前经历了多个候选边界和删除试验。在比较 long-to-short distillation 配方，或研究压缩究竟删除冗余、不确定性还是必要依赖时，这些 lineage 记录不可缺少。

可复用 schema 应保存任务条目与 split、教师 prompt 与版本、原始 rationale 与答案、初始及修订后的 chunk 边界、阶段标记、学生 checkpoint、每个候选的 loss、阈值决策、移除顺序、每次预测答案与正确性检查、保留/跳过标签、最终压缩轨迹及下游模型设置。训练时构造信号必须与评测准确率分开。缺少这些记录时，该论文主要是配方与审计清单，而不是开放数据源。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• CWT trains one rationale chunk at a time; SBC uses the current student's loss to revise boundaries.
  • STT treats answer correctness after chunk removal as the skip decision, not as proof of step irrelevance.
  • Teacher rationales use text-davinci-002, maximum length 128, and temperature 0.7 in the reported protocol.
  • The paper evaluates seven reasoning tasks, but some tasks retain nearly the full rationale and obtain little speedup.
  • No official processed traces or deletion logs were confirmed, so benchmark gains are not data-quality evidence.

• CWT 每次训练一个 rationale chunk；SBC 使用当前学生模型的 loss 修订边界。
  • STT 以删除 chunk 后答案是否正确作为跳过决策，但这不能证明该步骤无关。
  • 报告协议中的教师 rationale 由 text-davinci-002 以最大长度 128、temperature 0.7 生成。
  • 论文评测七项推理任务，但部分任务保留近乎完整的 rationale，提速很小。
  • 未确认官方处理后轨迹或删除日志，因此 benchmark 增益不是数据质量证据。
